sinopsis.es: Liz, recién divorciada, se reencuentra con su novio del secundario y retoman su chispa. A medida que la fantasía de una vida juntos se acerca, debe decidir si está lista para amar de nuevo.
sinopsis.en: Freshly divorced Liz crosses paths with her high school boyfriend — now a travel writer — and they rekindle their spark. As the fantasy of a life with him feels closer, she must decide if she's ready to love again.
